verdict.rationale: The evidence never documents a first-party way to select many notes and act on them at once, such as multi-select edit, batch property changes, or bulk move/delete. Bases lets you edit files and properties inside a database view, and renaming a file auto-updates internal links across the vault. Both are adjacent features, not bulk operations. The remaining evidence is either a user-side workaround (editing the plain-text files with external tools) or a developer building block (the plugin Vault API), and neither earns credit here.
